```{r}
oil_prices <- fred_df_raw |>
  select(series, date, value) |>
  rename(price = value)

aligned_time_window <- oil_prices |>
  summarize(start_date = min(date), end_date = max(date), .by = series) |>
  summarize(start_date = max(start_date), end_date = min(end_date))

oil_prices <- oil_prices |>
  filter(between(
    date,
    aligned_time_window$start_date,
    aligned_time_window$end_date
  ))

oil_prices <- oil_prices |>
  mutate(date_week = yearweek(date)) |>
  summarize(price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(series, date_week)) |>
  arrange(series, date_week) |>
  mutate(flag_imputed_price = is.na(price)) |>
  fill(price, .by = series, .direction = "down")

oil_prices <- as_tsibble(oil_prices, key = series, index = date_week)

has_gaps(oil_prices) |> pull(.gaps) |> any() == FALSE

oil_prices |>
  filter(is.na(price)) |>
  count(series)

glimpse(oil_prices)
```

```{r}
autoplot(oil_prices) +
  facet_wrap(vars(series), scale = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  guides(color = "none")
```

This code decomposes the series into components of

```{r}
ts_components <- oil_prices |>
  model(
    stl = STL(
      price ~ season(period = "1 year") # for weekly data, this maps to ~52
    )
  ) |>
  components() |>
  rename(year_effect = `season_1 year`)

ts_components |>
  select(
    series,
    date_week,
    price,
    trend,
    year_effect,
    remainder,
    season_adjust
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(series, date_week)) |>
  mutate(
    name = factor(
      name,
      levels = c(
        "price",
        "season_adjust",
        "trend",
        "year_effect",
        "remainder"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  autoplot() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name, series), scale = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  guides(color = "none")
```

The two series are highly correlated across various decompositions of the time series.

```{r}
ts_components |>
  select(
    series,
    date_week,
    price,
    trend,
    year_effect,
    remainder,
    season_adjust
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(series, date_week)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = series, values_from = value) |>
  ggplot(aes(us_consumer_gas, brent_crude)) +
  geom_point(size = .5, alpha = .3) +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free")
```

```{r}
us_oil_price <- oil_prices |>
  filter(series == "us_consumer_gas")

ts_test <- us_oil_price |>
  group_by(series) |>
  slice_tail(prop = .01) |>
  ungroup()

us_oil_price |>
  count(series)

ts_train <- anti_join(us_oil_price, ts_test, by = join_by(series, date_week))

ts_models <- ts_train |>
  model(
    naive = NAIVE(price),
    dcmp = decomposition_model(
      STL(log(price + 1) ~ season(period = "1 year")),
      ETS(season_adjust ~ season("N"))
    ),
    dhr = ARIMA(
      log(price + 1) ~ fourier(period = 365.25 / 7, K = 5) # adjust K via AICc
    )
  )

ts_models
```

```{r}
test_fc <- ts_models |>
  forecast(ts_test)

test_fc
```

```{r}
autoplot(test_fc, us_oil_price |> group_by(series) |> slice_tail(, prop = .2))
```

```{r}
test_acc <- accuracy(test_fc, us_oil_price) |>
  arrange(RMSE)

test_acc
```
